title: Villa, For Sale, Paphos, Universal
description: The Villa showcases a sleek, modern aesthetic with open-plan living spaces and kitchens featuring elegant granite worktops. Each bedroom includes fitted wardrobes, with the master bedroom offering the convenience of en-suite facilities. Outside, a private garden provides a peaceful retreat for relaxation and outdoor enjoyment. Other key features comprise off-plan options and large tiled balconies and verandas ideal for hosting gatherings.
